problem.en: Prepare the BRS of Rao & Co. as on 31 March 2025. Cash book (Dr) ₹25,000. Cheques issued not presented ₹6,000; cheques deposited not credited ₹4,500; bank charges ₹200; interest credited by bank ₹350; insurance premium paid by bank ₹1,200; dividend collected by bank ₹2,000.

steps.en: Add: cheques issued not presented 6,000 + interest credited 350 + dividend collected 2,000 = ₹8,350 → ₹33,350.
Less: cheques not credited 4,500 + bank charges 200 + insurance 1,200 = ₹5,900.

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. Prepare the BRS of Rao & Co. as on 31 March 2025. Cash book (Dr) ₹25,000. Cheques issued not presented ₹6,000; cheques deposited not credited ₹4,500; bank charges ₹200; interest credited by bank ₹350; insurance premium paid by bank ₹1,200; dividend collected by bank ₹2,000.

problem.en: Use the same data but start from the pass book balance of ₹27,450 to arrive at the cash book balance.

steps.en: Add: cheques not credited 4,500 + bank charges 200 + insurance 1,200 = ₹5,900 → ₹33,350.
Less: cheques not presented 6,000 + interest 350 + dividend 2,000 = ₹8,350.
Balance as per cash book = 33,350 − 8,350 = ₹25,000, which checks.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಒಂದು ಶಿಲ್ಕಿನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ, ಕಾರಣಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ ಕಳೆದು, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಶಿಲ್ಕು ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ. ನಗದು ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಶಿಲ್ಕಿನಿಂದ: ಸಲ್ಲಿಸದ ಚೆಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿ. ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾಗದ ಚೆಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಪಾಸ್ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಶಿಲ್ಕಿನಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಚಿಹ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ.
